chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, he said:
The thief is not to have his hand cut off during a year of drought.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakuni, the narrator in the chain
key_terms.جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سَنَةٍ مُجْدِبَةٍ: a year of drought and severe scarcity
key_terms.يُقْطَعُ: has the hand cut off as the legal punishment

ai.seo_question: Is the hadd punishment for theft suspended during a year of drought?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the hadd punishment for theft is not carried out during a time of severe drought and hardship. It indicates that social and economic conditions are relevant in applying criminal punishments in Islamic jurisprudence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5099 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), that he said:
"The hand of a thief is not to be cut off during a year of drought."
